senses.en: The particular way someone forms words when writing by hand.

ex.en: Your handwriting is much neater with this new pen.
ex.zh: 你用这支新笔写的字工整多了。

ex.en: Although digital devices are common in classrooms, clear handwriting remains useful for examinations and personal communication.
ex.zh: 虽然数字设备在课堂上很常见，但清晰的手写字在考试和个人交流中仍然有用。

tip: 通常不可数；优美书法这门艺术用calligraphy。

senses.en: to end a relationship, or to divide

ex.en: They split up after five years.
ex.zh: 他们五年后分手了。

ex.en: Let's split up and search the park.
ex.zh: 我们分开搜索公园吧。

tip: split up 表示“分手/分开”。
scene: Two people going different ways at a park path fork.

senses.en: the chance that something might happen or be true

senses.zh: 可考虑的选择；可能的事
senses.en: something that might happen or could be chosen

ex.en: There is a possibility of snow later tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚晚些时候可能会下雪。

ex.en: Improved public transport increases the possibility that commuters will leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通会增加通勤者不开车出行的可能性。

col: a real possibility｜确实存在的可能性
explore the possibilities｜探索各种可能的选择
rule out the possibility｜排除可能性
tip: 常用possibility of doing或possibility that从句。

senses.en: not one or the other of two
not either of two people or things
used to add another negative statement

ex.en: Neither jacket fits me, so I will keep looking.
ex.zh: 两件夹克都不合身，所以我会继续挑选。

ex.en: Neither approach can solve traffic congestion alone, so cities need a combination of investment and regulation.
ex.zh: 两种方法都无法单独解决交通拥堵，因此城市需要将投资与监管相结合。

col: neither of them｜他们两个都不
tip: neither只用于两者；接单数名词，常与nor搭配。

senses.en: to join things together or link them electronically
to recognize or establish a relationship between things
to develop a good relationship with someone

ex.en: Connect your phone to the speaker using this cable.
ex.zh: 用这根线把手机连接到音箱上。

ex.en: New rail services can connect rural communities with cities, improving access to education and employment.
ex.zh: 新的铁路服务可以连接农村社区与城市，让人们更容易获得教育和就业机会。

col: connect to the internet｜连接互联网
connect A with B｜把A与B联系起来
connect with people｜与人建立联系
tip: 连接设备常用connect A to B。

senses.en: Put your arms around someone and hold them close
An act of holding someone close with your arms

ex.en: Lena hugged her grandmother before leaving for school.
ex.zh: 莉娜上学前拥抱了奶奶。

ex.en: A reassuring hug from a parent can help young children manage stress in unfamiliar situations.
ex.zh: 父母一个令人安心的拥抱能帮助幼儿应对陌生环境中的压力。

col: give someone a hug｜拥抱某人
hug someone tightly｜紧紧拥抱某人
tip: 过去式hugged、现在分词hugging均双写g。

senses.zh: 有历史意义的；历史著名的
senses.en: Important in history or likely to be remembered in history.

ex.en: We crossed the historic bridge just before sunset.
ex.zh: 我们在日落前走过了那座历史名桥。

ex.en: Protecting historic buildings helps cities preserve their cultural identity while attracting visitors and supporting local businesses.
ex.zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市保留文化特色，同时吸引游客并支持当地商业。

col: historic agreement｜具有历史意义的协议
tip: historic强调历史意义；historical泛指与历史有关。

senses.en: buildings, rooms or equipment for a purpose

ex.en: The hotel has great sports facilities.
ex.zh: 这家酒店有很棒的运动设施。

ex.en: The school's facilities include a library and a gym.
ex.zh: 学校的设施包括图书馆和体育馆。

tip: facilities 常用复数，指场所提供的设施。
scene: A modern sports centre with a gym and swimming pool signs.

senses.en: a sport where you jump as far as possible

ex.en: He broke the school record in the long jump.
ex.zh: 他打破了学校跳远纪录。

ex.en: The long jump competition starts at ten.
ex.zh: 跳远比赛十点开始。

tip: long jump 是跳远；high jump 是跳高。
scene: An athlete jumping far into a sand pit at a sports field.

senses.en: an infectious illness causing fever, aches, and tiredness

ex.en: She stayed in bed all weekend with the flu.
ex.zh: 她得了流感，整个周末都卧床休息。

ex.en: Annual flu vaccinations can help protect vulnerable people and reduce pressure on hospitals during winter.
ex.zh: 每年接种流感疫苗有助于保护易感人群，并减轻冬季医院的压力。

tip: flu通常不可数；英式常说have flu，美式常加the。

senses.en: the sport or activity of riding horses

ex.en: She goes horse-riding every weekend.
ex.zh: 她每周末去骑马。

ex.en: Horse-riding is popular in the countryside.
ex.zh: 骑马在乡村很受欢迎。

tip: horse-riding 与 riding 都指骑马运动。
scene: A rider on a horse trotting through a green field.

senses.en: A metal container, especially for food, or its contents.
A soft, silver-coloured metal used to coat other metals.

ex.en: There is a tin of beans in the cupboard.
ex.zh: 橱柜里有一罐豆子。

ex.en: Reusing a metal tin for storage can reduce household waste and the need for new containers.
ex.zh: 重复利用金属罐储物，可以减少生活垃圾以及对新容器的需求。

tip: 罐子义可数，英式常用tin，美式常用can；锡不可数。

senses.en: A scientist who studies chemicals and how they react.
A pharmacist, or a shop that sells medicines, in British English.

ex.en: The chemist carefully poured the liquid into a glass tube.
ex.zh: 化学研究员小心地把液体倒进玻璃试管。

ex.en: Chemists are developing safer materials that could reduce the environmental impact of industrial production.
ex.zh: 化学家正在研发更安全的材料，以减轻工业生产对环境的影响。

tip: 英式中还指药剂师；chemist's常指药店。

senses.en: An unrestricted speech sound, or a letter representing such a sound.

ex.en: Our teacher stretched the vowel sound as we listened.
ex.zh: 老师把元音拉长，让我们仔细听。

ex.en: Recognising differences between vowel sounds can help language learners understand unfamiliar accents and communicate more clearly.
ex.zh: 辨别元音之间的差异有助于语言学习者理解陌生口音，并更清晰地交流。

tip: a或an的选择看后接词的首音是否为元音，不看字母。

senses.en: the worth, price, or importance of something
consider something important or estimate how much it is worth
beliefs about what is right and important in life

ex.en: This sturdy backpack offers excellent value for the price.
ex.zh: 这个结实的背包非常物有所值。

ex.en: Governments should recognise the value of public parks in improving physical health and strengthening community relationships.
ex.zh: 政府应认识到公共公园在改善身体健康和加强社区联系方面的价值。

col: place a high value on｜高度重视
tip: 表示“价值观”用复数values。

senses.en: A formal talk given to an audience.
The ability or act of expressing thoughts through spoken words.

ex.en: Leila practised her speech in front of the mirror.
ex.zh: 莱拉对着镜子练习演讲。

ex.en: In his speech, the researcher explained how access to green spaces can improve children's mental health.
ex.zh: 研究人员在演讲中解释了接触绿地如何改善儿童的心理健康。

tip: 一次演讲用a speech；说话能力通常不可数。

senses.en: The art and practice of designing buildings.
The style and appearance of buildings.
The way a computer system or other complex structure is organised.

ex.en: My brother studies architecture and builds tiny house models.
ex.zh: 我哥哥学建筑设计，还制作小房子模型。

ex.en: Sustainable architecture can reduce energy consumption by making better use of natural light and ventilation.
ex.zh: 可持续建筑设计可以更充分地利用自然采光和通风，从而降低能耗。

tip: architecture通常不可数；architect指建筑师。

senses.en: Caring about your own needs without considering other people

ex.en: It was selfish to take the whole cake.
ex.zh: 把整个蛋糕拿走太自私了。

ex.en: Selfish behaviour in shared housing can create tension and undermine trust among residents over time.
ex.zh: 合租住房中的自私行为会造成矛盾，并逐渐损害住户之间的信任。

col: selfish of someone｜某人这样做很自私
tip: 评价某人的行为用It is selfish of sb to do。

senses.en: a card you need to get on a plane

ex.en: Please show your boarding pass at the gate.
ex.zh: 请在登机口出示登机牌。

ex.en: She printed her boarding pass at home.
ex.zh: 她在家里打印了登机牌。

tip: boarding pass 是登机牌；boarding 是登机/上船。
scene: A hand holding a boarding pass at an airport gate.

senses.en: Older than another person, especially within the same family
An older person, especially one respected within a community

ex.en: My elder sister taught me how to ride a bicycle.
ex.zh: 我姐姐教会了我骑自行车。

ex.en: Community elders can help preserve local traditions by sharing their knowledge and experiences with younger generations.
ex.zh: 社区长者可以通过向年轻一代分享知识和经历，帮助传承当地传统。

tip: elder 多放在亲属名词前；比较年龄用 older than。

senses.en: Inside a particular area, period, or limit.
Inside something rather than outside it.

ex.en: Your parcel should arrive within the next three days.
ex.zh: 你的包裹应该会在接下来的三天内送达。

ex.en: Local authorities should ensure that essential services are available within walking distance of residential areas.
ex.zh: 地方政府应确保居民区步行可达的范围内有基本服务设施。

tip: within强调不超出某范围；within a week指一周内。

senses.en: make someone face an unpleasant consequence for doing wrong

ex.en: The referee punished the player for breaking the rules.
ex.zh: 裁判因那名球员违反规则而对其作出处罚。

ex.en: Schools should explain why behaviour is unacceptable rather than simply punish students without offering guidance.
ex.zh: 学校应解释为何某种行为不可接受，而不是只惩罚学生却不给予引导。

col: punish someone for something｜因某事惩罚某人
tip: punish sb for sth表示因某事惩罚某人。

senses.en: An opportunity to do something.
The likelihood that something will happen.
Events happening without planning or a predictable cause.

ex.en: Can you give me another chance to explain?
ex.zh: 你能再给我一次解释的机会吗？

ex.en: Affordable training gives unemployed adults a chance to gain new skills and return to the workforce.
ex.zh: 费用可负担的培训让失业的成年人有机会掌握新技能，重返职场。

col: a chance to learn｜学习的机会
a good chance of｜很有可能
tip: 机会用chance to do；可能性常用chance of doing。

senses.en: to put your hand or another body part against something
the sense of feeling things through skin, or physical contact
to make someone feel a strong, often tender emotion

ex.en: Please don't touch the pan; it is still hot.
ex.zh: 请别碰锅，它还很烫。

ex.en: Digital communication helps families stay in touch, even when work or study separates them across countries.
ex.zh: 即使工作或学习使家人分居不同国家，数字通信也能帮助他们保持联系。

tip: 保持联系用keep in touch with someone。

senses.en: to feel a steady pain that is usually not sharp
a steady pain that lasts for some time
to want something very deeply

ex.en: My legs ache after walking up all those stairs.
ex.zh: 爬完那么多级楼梯后，我的双腿酸痛。

ex.en: Office workers whose backs ache regularly may benefit from adjustable desks and more frequent movement breaks.
ex.zh: 经常背痛的办公室职员可能会受益于可调节办公桌和更频繁的活动休息。

tip: ache多指持续钝痛；pain可泛指各种疼痛。

senses.en: a place serving meals in a school or workplace
a container used to carry drinking water outdoors

ex.en: We usually eat lunch together in the school canteen.
ex.zh: 我们通常一起在学校食堂吃午饭。

ex.en: Providing affordable healthy meals in the workplace canteen can improve employee wellbeing and productivity.
ex.zh: 在工作场所的食堂提供价格实惠的健康餐食，可以改善员工的身心健康并提高生产力。

tip: 英式英语中常指食堂；美式英语常用cafeteria。

senses.en: Find an answer to a problem or mystery

ex.en: We solved the puzzle together after dinner last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚晚饭后，我们一起解开了那道谜题。

ex.en: Improving public transport could help solve traffic problems in rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通有助于解决快速发展城区的交通问题。

tip: solve直接接问题；“溶解”用dissolve。

senses.en: The same in amount, value, status, or opportunity.
To be the same in quantity, value, or quality.
Someone with the same status, ability, or rights as another.

ex.en: We divided the cake into equal pieces for everyone.
ex.zh: 我们把蛋糕切成大小相等的小块，分给大家。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that children from all backgrounds have equal access to quality education and essential healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应确保各种背景的儿童都能平等地获得优质教育和基本医疗服务。

col: treat as an equal｜平等对待
tip: 形容词常接to；动词equal直接接宾语，不加to。

senses.en: To have a different opinion from someone else.
To give different information or results.

ex.en: We disagree about which colour to paint the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们对于厨房该刷什么颜色意见不一。

ex.en: Experts disagree on whether free public transport is the most effective way to reduce urban traffic.
ex.zh: 专家对于免费公共交通是否是减少城市交通流量的最有效方法意见不一。

col: disagree with someone｜不同意某人的看法
disagree about something｜在某事上意见不合
tip: 不同意某人用disagree with；争议话题用on或about。

senses.en: to stop doing something or leave a job

ex.en: He quit his job to travel around the world.
ex.zh: 他辞职去环游世界。

ex.en: She quit smoking last year.
ex.zh: 她去年戒烟了。

tip: quit 是“放弃/辞职/停止”；过去式 quit。
scene: A person handing in a letter at an office desk.

senses.en: To stop working permanently, usually because of age.
To leave a competition before finishing it.

ex.en: My aunt plans to retire and spend more time gardening.
ex.zh: 我姑姑打算退休，多花些时间种花种菜。

ex.en: As life expectancy increases, some governments encourage people to retire later to reduce pressure on pension systems.
ex.zh: 随着预期寿命延长，一些政府鼓励人们推迟退休，以减轻养老金制度的压力。

col: retire from a race｜退出比赛
tip: retire是动词；“退休”这一名词用retirement。

senses.en: A person who writes books, articles, or other written works.
To write a book, report, or other written work.

ex.en: The author answered questions about her new adventure novel.
ex.zh: 这位作者回答了有关她新出版的冒险小说的问题。

ex.en: An author can challenge social attitudes by presenting familiar problems through the experiences of unfamiliar characters.
ex.zh: 作者可以借助陌生人物的经历呈现熟悉的问题，从而挑战社会观念。

col: the author of a novel｜一部小说的作者
tip: “……的作者”用the author of；也可作动词。

senses.en: to get rid of something

ex.en: Don't throw away the box; we can reuse it.
ex.zh: 别扔掉盒子，我们可以再利用。

ex.en: She threw away the old newspapers.
ex.zh: 她扔掉了旧报纸。

tip: throw away 是“扔掉”；注意环保，减少乱扔。
scene: A hand throwing a paper box into a recycling bin.

senses.en: To have to pay money back to someone.
To have a duty to give someone something.
To have something because of someone's help or another cause.

ex.en: I still owe my sister money for the tickets.
ex.zh: 我还欠姐姐买票的钱。

ex.en: Many successful students owe their progress to consistent practice rather than exceptional natural ability.
ex.zh: 许多优秀学生的进步归功于持续练习，而非非凡的天赋。

col: owe an apology｜应向某人道歉
owe a debt of gratitude｜深受恩惠
owe success to｜把成功归功于
tip: owe A to B可指欠B东西A，也可指把A归功于B。

senses.en: to entertain an audience by acting, singing, or playing music
to carry out a task, action, or duty
to work or achieve results in a particular way

ex.en: Our choir will perform at the community centre tonight.
ex.zh: 我们的合唱团今晚将在社区中心演出。

ex.en: Students often perform better academically when schools provide regular feedback and access to individual support.
ex.zh: 学校提供定期反馈和个别支持时，学生的学业表现往往更好。

tip: 既可指表演，也可接task、duty表示执行。

senses.en: The quality of having great value or a strong effect.

ex.en: Losing my keys taught me the importance of a spare.
ex.zh: 丢了钥匙后，我才明白备用钥匙有多重要。

ex.en: Schools should emphasise the importance of critical thinking rather than focusing only on examination results.
ex.zh: 学校应强调批判性思维的重要性，而不是只关注考试成绩。

col: recognise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip: importance不可数；重视某事用attach importance to。

senses.en: A small, round, green seed eaten as a vegetable

ex.en: She added frozen peas to the vegetable soup.
ex.zh: 她往蔬菜汤里加了些冷冻豌豆。

ex.en: Growing peas and other vegetables at school can help children understand where their food comes from.
ex.zh: 在学校种植豌豆和其他蔬菜，可以帮助孩子了解食物的来源。

tip: 可数名词；泛指食用的豌豆通常用复数peas。

senses.en: To have a plan or purpose in mind.
To mean something or design it for a particular purpose.

ex.en: I intend to finish painting the kitchen this weekend.
ex.zh: 我打算这周末刷完厨房。

ex.en: The council intends to expand public transport services to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 地方议会打算扩大公共交通服务，以减少人们对私家车的依赖。

col: intend to do something｜打算做某事
tip: intend to do表示打算做；be intended for表示供……用。

senses.zh: 色彩鲜艳的；五彩缤纷的
senses.en: Having many bright colours

senses.zh: 生动有趣的；丰富多彩的
senses.en: Full of interesting, unusual or exciting details

ex.en: Colourful balloons floated above the tables at the party.
ex.zh: 聚会上，五彩缤纷的气球飘浮在桌子上方。

ex.en: Colourful public murals can transform neglected urban spaces and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 色彩鲜艳的公共壁画能改变被忽视的城市空间，增强居民对社区的自豪感。

col: a colourful character｜有趣独特的人物
a colourful history｜丰富多彩的历史
tip: 英式拼写colourful，美式拼写colorful。

senses.en: rising or falling at a sharp angle
describing a sharp change or an unusually high price
to leave something in liquid to release flavour or soften it

ex.en: We pushed our bikes up the steep hill.
ex.zh: 我们推着自行车爬上了陡坡。

ex.en: A steep rise in housing costs can force young workers to move away from major cities.
ex.zh: 住房成本急剧上涨可能迫使年轻劳动者离开大城市。

tip: steep既形容坡陡，也形容价格高或变化剧烈。

senses.en: as stated or reported by someone or something
following a rule, plan, or particular standard

ex.en: According to the forecast, rain will arrive this afternoon.
ex.zh: 据天气预报，今天下午会下雨。

ex.en: According to recent research, regular physical activity can improve concentration and reduce stress among university students.
ex.zh: 根据近期研究，经常进行体育活动可以提高大学生的专注力并减轻压力。

col: according to the rules｜按照规则
tip: 引述他人观点用according to；自己的观点用in my opinion。

senses.en: To crush something flat or squeeze into a small space
An indoor racket sport played by hitting a ball against walls
A vegetable with thick skin and a soft, seed-filled centre

ex.en: Don't squash the bread under those heavy shopping bags.
ex.zh: 别把面包压在那些沉重的购物袋下面。

ex.en: Playing squash regularly can improve cardiovascular fitness, although beginners should increase the intensity of exercise gradually.
ex.zh: 经常打壁球可以增强心肺功能，不过初学者应逐步提高运动强度。

tip: 英式英语中还可指需加水稀释的浓缩果汁饮料。

senses.en: Very unpleasant to experience, taste, smell, or see.
Deliberately unkind or hurtful towards another person.
Severe or painful, especially describing an illness or injury.

ex.en: A nasty smell came from the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 厨房垃圾桶里散发出一股难闻的气味。

ex.en: Nasty comments on social media can discourage young people from participating in otherwise valuable online discussions.
ex.zh: 社交媒体上的恶意评论可能使年轻人不愿参与原本有价值的网络讨论。

tip: 比bad更带厌恶感；形容人时通常指刻薄、不友善。

senses.en: to interrupt someone's activity, rest, or peace
to make someone feel worried or upset
to move or change something from its usual position

ex.en: Please close the door quietly so you don't disturb Dad.
ex.zh: 请轻轻关门，别打扰爸爸。

ex.en: Construction noise can disturb nearby residents and reduce their quality of life over time.
ex.zh: 施工噪声可能打扰附近居民，并逐渐降低他们的生活质量。

col: disturb someone's sleep｜打扰某人睡眠
tip: disturb强调打扰或使不安；interrupt强调中断。

senses.en: painful, especially when touched or moved
a painful damaged area on the skin
upset or annoyed about something unfair or disappointing

ex.en: My legs are sore after yesterday's long walk.
ex.zh: 昨天走了很远的路，我的腿现在酸痛。

ex.en: Office workers may develop sore muscles if they remain seated without taking regular breaks.
ex.zh: 上班族如果久坐而不定时休息，可能会出现肌肉酸痛。

tip: sore常修饰身体部位，如a sore throat。

senses.en: The distance from a surface to the bottom.
The degree of detail, understanding, or seriousness.

ex.en: Check the depth before you jump into the pool.
ex.zh: 跳进泳池前先确认水深。

ex.en: University courses should encourage students to explore complex environmental issues in greater depth.
ex.zh: 大学课程应鼓励学生更深入地探讨复杂的环境问题。

tip: in depth表示“深入地”，不是“在深处”。

senses.en: a number expressing an amount, especially in official information
a person, their outline, or the shape of their body
to think or decide something after considering it

ex.en: She checked the final figure on the bill.
ex.zh: 她核对了账单上的最终金额。

ex.en: Recent employment figures suggest that investment in public transport can create substantial opportunities for local workers.
ex.zh: 近期就业数据显示，投资公共交通能为当地劳动者创造大量机会。

tip: 数据常用复数figures；figure out意为弄懂。

senses.en: a piece of furniture with drawers for clothes

ex.en: My socks are in the chest of drawers.
ex.zh: 我的袜子在五斗柜里。

ex.en: The wooden chest of drawers stands by the bed.
ex.zh: 木抽屉柜放在床边。

tip: chest of drawers 是带多个抽屉的衣柜。
scene: A wooden chest of drawers with open drawers showing folded clothes.

senses.en: A member of the police.
A member of the armed forces with authority to command.
Someone with an official role in an organisation or government.

ex.en: A police officer helped us find the station.
ex.zh: 一位警察帮我们找到了车站。

ex.en: A local housing officer can advise residents on applying for affordable accommodation and accessing financial support.
ex.zh: 当地住房事务官员可以指导居民申请可负担住房并获取经济援助。

tip: officer可指警察或军官，具体含义看搭配。

senses.en: A wide-mouthed container, often glass, with a lid.
To feel unpleasant or clash with something.
To shake suddenly and sharply, sometimes causing pain.

ex.en: She keeps homemade jam in a small glass jar.
ex.zh: 她把自制果酱装在一个小玻璃罐里。

ex.en: Reusing glass jars for food storage can help households reduce their reliance on disposable plastic packaging.
ex.zh: 重复使用玻璃罐储存食品可以帮助家庭减少对一次性塑料包装的依赖。

col: a jar of honey｜一罐蜂蜜
jar with the surroundings｜与周围环境不协调
tip: jar 常指有盖广口罐；a jar of 后接所装物。

senses.en: Successfully reach a goal or result through effort.

ex.en: With daily practice, she finally achieved her swimming goal.
ex.zh: 通过每天练习，她终于实现了自己的游泳目标。

ex.en: Governments can achieve significant reductions in air pollution by investing in clean energy and improving public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过投资清洁能源和改善公共交通，大幅减少空气污染。

tip: 直接接目标或成果，不说achieve to do。

senses.en: on a ship, plane or vehicle

ex.en: All passengers are now on board the plane.
ex.zh: 所有乘客都已登机。

ex.en: Welcome on board the train to London.
ex.zh: 欢迎乘坐开往伦敦的火车。

tip: on board 表示“在交通工具上”，如 get on board 登机/上船。
scene: Passengers boarding a plane through the door.

senses.en: containing a lot of moisture in the air

ex.en: It feels so humid that my shirt sticks to me.
ex.zh: 天气湿热得我的衬衫都贴在身上了。

ex.en: In humid climates, buildings require effective ventilation to prevent mould growth and protect residents' health.
ex.zh: 在潮湿气候中，建筑物需要有效通风，以防止霉菌滋生并保护居民健康。

tip: humid主要形容空气或气候潮湿，不用于湿衣服。

senses.en: the period of life when someone is young
young people considered as a group
a young man, especially a teenager

ex.en: My grandmother spent her youth in a seaside village.
ex.zh: 我祖母的青年时代是在一个海边村庄度过的。

ex.en: Investment in youth services can give young people valuable skills and strengthen their sense of belonging.
ex.zh: 对青年服务的投资能让年轻人掌握实用技能，并增强他们的归属感。

col: in one's youth｜在某人年轻时
tip: 表示青春通常不可数；a youth指一名年轻男子。

senses.en: a traditional or usual way of behaving
made to meet a particular customer's needs
the business customers give to a shop or company

ex.en: Sharing a meal is an important custom in our family.
ex.zh: 一起吃饭是我们家的一项重要惯例。

ex.en: Schools can introduce children to local customs while encouraging respect for traditions from other cultures.
ex.zh: 学校可以向孩子们介绍当地风俗，同时鼓励他们尊重其他文化的传统。

tip: custom指风俗或惯例；customs还可指海关。

senses.en: Become greater in amount or size, or make something greater
A rise in the amount, size, or level of something

ex.en: The bakery increased its prices again this week.
ex.zh: 这家面包店本周又涨价了。

ex.en: An increase in public transport investment could reduce traffic congestion and improve air quality in cities.
ex.zh: 增加公共交通投资可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。

col: an increase in demand｜需求的增长
tip: 动词重音在后，名词在前；by接增量，to接终值。

senses.en: an official card that allows you to drive

ex.en: He passed his driving test and got a licence.
ex.zh: 他通过了驾驶考试，拿到了驾照。

ex.en: She forgot her driving licence at home.
ex.zh: 她把驾照忘在家里了。

tip: driving licence 是英式拼写；美式是 driver's license。
scene: A driving licence card lying on a car seat.

senses.en: a person walking rather than travelling in a vehicle
intended for or relating to people travelling on foot
ordinary and lacking imagination or excitement

ex.en: The driver stopped to let a pedestrian cross.
ex.zh: 司机停车让一位行人过马路。

ex.en: Wider pavements and safer crossings can protect pedestrians and encourage residents to walk instead of driving.
ex.zh: 更宽的人行道和更安全的过街设施可以保护行人，鼓励居民步行而非开车。

tip: 作名词指行人；作形容词也可指作品平庸乏味。

senses.en: One or the other of two; each of two sides.
One or the other of two people or things.
Also not, used after a negative statement.

ex.en: You can borrow either umbrella; both are dry.
ex.zh: 两把伞你随便借哪把都行，都是干的。

ex.en: Students can choose either vocational training or university education, depending on their interests and career goals.
ex.zh: 学生可以根据自己的兴趣和职业目标，选择职业培训或大学教育。

col: either side｜两边中的任一边；两边各自
either of them｜他们两者中的任一个
tip: either…or…表二选一；否定句末either表“也不”。

senses.en: in or to any place, regardless of where
used in questions to express surprise about a place

ex.en: You can sit wherever you feel most comfortable.
ex.zh: 你觉得哪里最舒服，就可以坐在哪里。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that children receive a good education wherever they live, including in remote rural communities.
ex.zh: 政府应确保儿童无论住在哪里，包括偏远农村地区，都能接受良好教育。

col: wherever possible｜在任何可能的地方
wherever you go｜无论你去哪里
wherever you live｜无论你住在哪里
tip: 表示“无论哪里”时，相当于no matter where。

senses.en: Your name written in your own distinctive way
Distinctive and closely associated with a particular person or place

ex.en: The delivery driver asked for my signature at the door.
ex.zh: 送货司机在门口请我签名。

ex.en: Electronic signatures allow businesses to complete agreements remotely, reducing delays and the need for paper documents.
ex.zh: 电子签名让企业能够远程签订协议，减少延误和纸质文件的使用。

tip: signature通常指签名；名人纪念签名常用autograph。

senses.en: completely or without any doubt
used to express strong agreement with someone

ex.en: The kitchen was absolutely spotless after we cleaned it.
ex.zh: 我们打扫后，厨房一尘不染。

ex.en: Reliable internet access is absolutely essential for students participating in online courses from remote communities.
ex.zh: 对于偏远社区参加在线课程的学生来说，可靠的网络连接必不可少。

tip: 常修饰essential等极限形容词，不常说absolutely good。

senses.en: A change that fixes an error, or the act of fixing it.

ex.en: I made a correction before sending the email.
ex.zh: 我在发送邮件前改正了一处错误。

ex.en: Timely correction of factual errors helps news organizations maintain public trust and prevent misinformation from spreading.
ex.zh: 及时纠正事实错误有助于新闻机构维持公众信任，并防止错误信息传播。

tip: 具体一处修改可数；泛指纠正过程时常不可数。

senses.en: written with a pen, not a pencil

ex.en: Please write your name in ink on the form.
ex.zh: 请用墨水笔在表格上写名字。

ex.en: The exam must be answered in ink.
ex.zh: 考试必须用墨水笔作答。

tip: in ink 是“用钢笔写”；in pencil 用铅笔写。
scene: A hand writing with a blue pen on a form.

senses.en: a loving relationship or the excitement and affection surrounding love
a story or film mainly about love

ex.en: Their romance began during a walking holiday in the mountains.
ex.zh: 他们的恋情始于一次山间徒步假期。

ex.en: Popular films often portray romance in idealised ways, which may shape young people's expectations of relationships.
ex.zh: 流行电影常以理想化的方式描绘爱情，这可能影响年轻人对恋爱关系的期待。

col: a whirlwind romance｜迅速发展的恋情
tip: 泛指爱情常不可数；指一段恋情或一部作品可数。

senses.en: a way taken to get from one place to another
to send someone or something along a particular path

ex.en: We took a different route home to avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 我们换了一条路线回家，以避开拥堵。

ex.en: Expanding bus routes to rural communities would improve access to employment and essential public services.
ex.zh: 将公交线路延伸至农村社区，有助于居民获得就业机会和基本公共服务。

tip: 美式也读 /raʊt/；route 强调行进路线。

senses.en: Very useful or important for a particular purpose.
Worth a large amount of money.

ex.en: My neighbour gave me valuable advice about growing tomatoes.
ex.zh: 邻居给了我一些种番茄的宝贵建议。

ex.en: Work placements provide valuable experience that helps students develop practical skills before entering full-time employment.
ex.zh: 实习提供宝贵经验，帮助学生在正式就业前培养实践技能。

tip: 贵重物品用复数valuables；invaluable意为极宝贵的。

senses.en: connected with history or events in the past

ex.en: We found historical photographs of our street in the library.
ex.zh: 我们在图书馆找到了这条街过去的照片。

ex.en: Historical records help researchers understand how earlier societies responded to environmental change and economic uncertainty.
ex.zh: 历史记录帮助研究人员了解过去的社会如何应对环境变化和经济不确定性。

tip: historical指与历史有关；historic强调具有历史意义。

senses.en: Medical treatment involving cutting into the body.
The functioning or management of a machine, system, or business.
A planned activity involving several people working together.

ex.en: My aunt is recovering well after her knee operation.
ex.zh: 我姑姑膝盖手术后恢复得很好。

ex.en: The successful operation of public transport systems depends on reliable funding and careful long-term planning.
ex.zh: 公共交通系统的成功运作有赖于可靠的资金支持和周密的长期规划。

tip: 手术部位用on连接：an operation on the knee。

senses.en: Belief that someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe.
To believe someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe.
An arrangement or organisation managing money or property for others.

ex.en: I trust my neighbour to feed our cat.
ex.zh: 我信得过邻居，放心让他喂我们的猫。

ex.en: Public trust in scientific advice depends partly on how clearly researchers communicate uncertainty and evidence.
ex.zh: 公众对科学建议的信任，部分取决于研究人员能否清晰地说明不确定性和证据。

col: trust someone to do something｜相信某人会做某事
a charitable trust｜慈善信托机构
tip: trust sb to do sth表示相信某人能可靠地做某事。

senses.en: a period spent doing a particular activity
a formal meeting or period when an official body meets

ex.en: Our first swimming session starts early tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 我们的第一次游泳课明天一早开始。

ex.en: Regular revision sessions help students retain information more effectively than studying intensively just before examinations.
ex.zh: 定期复习比临考前突击学习更能帮助学生有效记住知识。

col: in session｜正在开会；正在开庭
tip: session强调一段活动时间；semester才通常指学期。

senses.en: needed for a particular purpose or situation

ex.en: Take a warm coat if you think it's necessary.
ex.zh: 如果你觉得有必要，就带上一件暖和的外套。

ex.en: Investment in public transport is necessary to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通对于缓解交通拥堵和改善城市空气质量是必要的。

tip: 常用it is necessary to do；necessarily意为“必然地”。

senses.en: To offer an idea or possible action for consideration.
To indicate that something may be true.

ex.en: I suggest taking an umbrella because those clouds look dark.
ex.zh: 我建议带把伞，因为那些云看起来很阴沉。

ex.en: Recent studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among urban residents.
ex.zh: 近期研究表明，能够接触绿地可能有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。

col: suggest a solution｜提出解决方案
tip: 用suggest doing或suggest that从句，不用suggest to do。

senses.en: In most cases or on most occasions.
In a way that shows the usual qualities of something.

ex.en: Our neighbours typically walk their dog before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居通常在早餐前遛狗。

ex.en: Cities with reliable public transport typically experience less traffic congestion than those dependent on private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通可靠的城市通常比依赖私家车的城市交通拥堵更少。

tip: 通常放在实义动词前、be动词后。

senses.en: a system that cools the air in a room

ex.en: The office has air conditioning, so it's cool in summer.
ex.zh: 办公室有空调，夏天很凉快。

ex.en: Please turn on the air conditioning; it's so hot.
ex.zh: 太热了，请打开空调。

tip: air conditioning 常缩写为 A/C；air-conditioned 是“有空调的”。
scene: A wall air conditioning unit blowing cool air in a hot room.

senses.en: Untidy or dirty, with things scattered or out of place.
Complicated and difficult to deal with.

ex.en: His desk was messy after an afternoon of painting.
ex.zh: 画了一下午画后，他的书桌变得脏乱不堪。

ex.en: Without clear responsibilities, cooperation between public agencies can become messy and delay the delivery of essential services.
ex.zh: 如果没有明确的职责，公共机构之间的合作可能变得混乱，延误基本服务的提供。

tip: messy可指物品脏乱，也可指局面复杂难处理。

senses.en: Happening without being expected or predicted.

ex.en: An unexpected visitor arrived just as we finished lunch.
ex.zh: 我们刚吃完午饭，一位意想不到的客人就来了。

ex.en: Governments need emergency funds to manage unexpected events without reducing essential spending on healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 政府需要应急资金来应对意外事件，避免削减医疗和教育方面的必要支出。

tip: unexpected强调未料到，不一定表示突然发生。

senses.en: To formally express a choice in an election or decision.
A formal expression of choice, or the process of choosing.

ex.en: We voted to hold the picnic in the park.
ex.zh: 我们投票决定在公园里野餐。

ex.en: Allowing residents to vote on local projects may increase public participation in community development.
ex.zh: 允许居民就地方项目投票，可能提高公众参与社区发展的积极性。

tip: vote for表示支持；vote against表示反对。

senses.en: mainly, or for the largest part

ex.en: My weekend was mostly spent cooking and reading.
ex.zh: 我的周末大部分时间都用来做饭和看书了。

ex.en: In many rural areas, residents rely mostly on private vehicles because public transport services are limited.
ex.zh: 在许多农村地区，由于公共交通服务有限，居民主要依靠私家车出行。

tip: mostly指大部分情况；almost指差一点或几乎。

senses.en: at the correct time

ex.en: The train arrived on time.
ex.zh: 火车准点到达。

ex.en: Please be on time for the meeting.
ex.zh: 请准时参加会议。

tip: on time 是“准时”；in time 是“及时”。
scene: A station clock showing the exact time as a train arrives.

senses.en: to continue doing something

ex.en: Carry on with your work; I'll wait outside.
ex.zh: 继续你的工作，我在外面等。

ex.en: She carried on talking even after the bell rang.
ex.zh: 铃响后她还在继续说。

tip: carry on (with) 是“继续做某事”。
scene: A student continuing to write notes while others pack up.

senses.en: to move quickly back and forth, or cause this movement
to upset someone deeply or weaken their confidence
a quick movement back and forth

ex.en: Shake the bottle well before pouring juice into your glass.
ex.zh: 把果汁倒进杯子前，先充分摇匀瓶子。

ex.en: Repeated failures in public transport can shake commuters' confidence in the reliability of urban services.
ex.zh: 公共交通反复出现故障，可能动摇通勤者对城市服务可靠性的信心。

tip: 不规则变化：shake—shook—shaken。

senses.en: Stop blaming someone or feeling angry about what they did.
Officially allow someone not to repay a debt.

ex.en: Can you forgive me for breaking your favourite mug?
ex.zh: 我打碎了你最喜欢的杯子，你能原谅我吗？

ex.en: International lenders may forgive some debts to help poorer countries invest more in healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 国际贷款机构可能减免部分债务，帮助较贫困国家增加医疗和教育投入。

col: forgive someone for something｜原谅某人某事
tip: 用forgive sb for doing sth；过去式forgave，过去分词forgiven。

senses.en: a person who controls a machine or piece of equipment
a person or company that runs a business or service
a person who connects calls or provides telephone assistance

ex.en: The crane operator carefully lowered the beam into place.
ex.zh: 起重机操作员小心地把横梁降到指定位置。

ex.en: Every public transport operator should ensure that its services remain accessible to passengers with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 每家公共交通运营商都应确保行动不便的乘客能够使用其服务。

col: mobile network operator｜移动网络运营商
tip: 既指操作设备的人，也指经营服务的公司。

senses.en: the bags and suitcases you take when travelling
past experiences or feelings that continue to cause difficulties

ex.en: Our baggage arrived on the next flight this afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们的行李今天下午随下一班飞机到了。

ex.en: Airlines often charge additional fees for checked baggage, increasing the overall cost of travel.
ex.zh: 航空公司常对托运行李额外收费，从而增加旅行的总费用。

tip: 不可数；一件行李说a piece of baggage。

senses.en: willing to give money, time, or help freely
larger or more plentiful than usual or expected

ex.en: Our generous neighbour shared her fresh vegetables with us.
ex.zh: 我们那位大方的邻居把新鲜蔬菜分给了我们。

ex.en: Generous donations from local businesses can help community centres provide affordable activities for children and older residents.
ex.zh: 当地企业的慷慨捐助可以帮助社区中心为儿童和老年居民提供价格实惠的活动。

col: generous with your time｜不吝惜时间
tip: be generous with sth表示在某方面慷慨。

senses.en: a place open at night for music and dancing

ex.en: The nightclub was very crowded on Friday.
ex.zh: 周五夜店非常拥挤。

ex.en: You must be over eighteen to enter the nightclub.
ex.zh: 年满十八岁才能进夜店。

tip: nightclub 是夜店；注意未成年人禁止进入。
scene: A neon-lit nightclub entrance with music signs at night.

senses.en: Water covering land that is normally dry.
To cover with water or become covered with water.
A large amount of something arriving at once.

ex.en: The flood left our garden covered in thick mud.
ex.zh: 洪水退去后，我们的花园覆满了厚厚的淤泥。

ex.en: Restoring wetlands can reduce flood risks by allowing excess rainwater to spread and drain naturally.
ex.zh: 恢复湿地可以让多余雨水自然扩散和排走，从而降低洪灾风险。

col: a flood of complaints｜大量涌来的投诉
tip: 读音与 blood 的元音相同，不与 food 押韵。

senses.en: television

ex.en: We watched the match on TV.
ex.zh: 我们在电视上看了比赛。

ex.en: The TV is in the living room.
ex.zh: 电视在客厅里。

tip: TV 是 television 的缩写；watch TV 看电视。
scene: A family watching a match on TV in a living room.

senses.en: An act of cutting hair, or the resulting hairstyle.

ex.en: I need a haircut before my cousin's wedding.
ex.zh: 表亲的婚礼之前，我需要理个发。

ex.en: Offering affordable haircuts at community centres can help trainee hairdressers gain practical experience while serving local residents.
ex.zh: 在社区中心提供价格实惠的理发服务，能让实习理发师在服务当地居民的同时积累实践经验。

tip: 说get或have a haircut，不说cut a haircut。

senses.en: having the usual features of a particular group or situation
showing the behaviour or qualities usually associated with someone

ex.en: A typical weekday starts with breakfast and a walk.
ex.zh: 平常的工作日都是从吃早餐和散步开始的。

ex.en: Long commuting times are typical of large cities where housing near employment centres is expensive.
ex.zh: 在就业中心附近住房昂贵的大城市，通勤时间长是常见现象。

tip: 用typical of表示具有某人或某物的典型特征。

senses.en: the state of having no job

ex.en: Unemployment in the town has risen this year.
ex.zh: 今年这个镇的失业率上升了。

ex.en: The government is trying to reduce unemployment.
ex.zh: 政府正努力降低失业率。

tip: unemployment 是“失业/失业率”；unemployed 是“失业的”。
scene: A job centre with people reading vacancy boards.

senses.en: to believe that something will probably happen
to regard something as necessary or reasonably required
to believe someone or something will arrive soon

ex.en: We expect rain, so take an umbrella with you.
ex.zh: 我们预计会下雨，所以带上雨伞吧。

ex.en: Employers increasingly expect graduates to demonstrate practical skills as well as a strong understanding of their subject.
ex.zh: 雇主越来越期望毕业生既展现实践技能，又具备扎实的专业知识。

col: expect to do something｜预计做某事
expect someone to do something｜期望某人做某事
tip: expect偏重认为会发生，hope偏重希望发生。

senses.en: a tropical fruit with rough skin and sweet yellow flesh

ex.en: She sliced a fresh pineapple for our picnic.
ex.zh: 她为我们的野餐切了一个新鲜菠萝。

ex.en: Growing pineapple for export can support rural incomes, but intensive farming may damage local soils.
ex.zh: 种植菠萝用于出口可以增加农村收入，但集约化种植可能损害当地土壤。

tip: 整个菠萝可数，作为食物的菠萝果肉常不可数。

senses.en: the feeling or mood of a place or situation
the mixture of gases surrounding a planet

ex.en: Soft lighting gave the little restaurant a relaxed atmosphere.
ex.zh: 柔和的灯光为这家小餐馆营造了轻松的氛围。

ex.en: A supportive classroom atmosphere encourages students to ask questions and participate more actively in discussions.
ex.zh: 相互支持的课堂氛围鼓励学生提问，并更加积极地参与讨论。

tip: 表示某种氛围常用an atmosphere；地球大气用the atmosphere。

senses.en: certainly; used to agree

ex.en: 'Can you help me?' 'Of course!'
ex.zh: “你能帮我吗？”“当然！”

ex.en: Of course, I'll come to your party.
ex.zh: 我当然会来参加你的聚会。

tip: of course 表示“当然”，是肯定回答。
scene: A person nodding and smiling while saying of course.

senses.en: One of the hard parts forming a body's supporting frame.
To remove the bones from meat or fish.

ex.en: He broke a bone in his wrist while skating.
ex.zh: 他滑冰时摔断了手腕的一块骨头。

ex.en: Regular weight-bearing exercise helps maintain bone strength and can reduce the risk of fractures in older adults.
ex.zh: 规律的负重运动有助于保持骨骼强度，并能降低老年人骨折的风险。

tip: bone作动词指去骨；boneless表示无骨的。
